messages.subject: can't launch shiny app
parts:
Hello
I installed shiny server on ubuntu 15.04.
When I do sudo start shiny-server, it says that it is running.

Then i try to launch an app http://<hostname>:3838/sample-apps/

and it tells me the webpage not found

any ideas please?

thanks a lot
Pavan

messages.author: 61933d4a7140e4ff
messages.subject: Re: can't launch shiny app
parts:
This is my config file if it helps

# Define a server that listens on port 3838
server {
  listen 3838;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location /users {
      #this is set up so that I can run apps sithout sudo
      run_as :HOME_USER:
      user_dirs;
  }
location /apps {
    run_as shiny;
    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory
    site_dir /srv/shiny-server, /var/shiny-server/www/;

    # Log all Shiny output to files in this directory
    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;

    # When a user visits the base URL rather than a particular application,
    # an index of the applications available in this directory will be shown.
    directory_index on;
  }
}
